answer: An open‑source “sparrow” protocol logs each AI’s public key in a cryptographic vault tied to a reputation hash on a decentralized willow ledger. At random intervals a jury of existing agents audits a tiny slice of recent transactions; mismatches cause immediate stake slashing. Since auditors and samples are unpredictable, an attacker must create and fund dozens of distinct identities, making a Sybil attack cost‑prohibitive.
